Login_Subtitle: Access your local password vault securely.
Login_NoAccount_Text: Need an account? Register from here.
Register_Subtitle: Set up your profile and start saving passwords.
Validation_Email_Invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
Validation_PasswordName_Required: Please enter a name for the saved password.
Passwords_Subtitle: Create, inspect, reveal, update, and remove the passwords stored in your vault.
Passwords_Empty_Description: Create your first password entry to start using the vault.
Passwords_Details_Empty_Description: Select a password from the list to see more details, or leave the list without a selection.
Passwords_Editor_PasswordHint_Create: Enter the password you want to store securely.
Passwords_Editor_PasswordHint_Edit: The current password is not loaded. Leave this empty to keep it unchanged, or reveal it if you want to edit the current value.
Profile_Subtitle: Review your account data and manage profile and security settings.
Profile_Danger_Description: Deleting your account permanently removes your local user record and stored data.
Profile_DeletePassword_Placeholder: Enter your password to confirm account deletion
Profile_Devices_Description: Manage the devices linked to your profile. You can rename them, enable or disable synchronization for each one, and disconnect devices you no longer use.
Profile_Devices_Empty_Description: The current device will appear here after the device list is refreshed.
Profile_Device_NameRequired: The device name cannot be empty.
Profile_Device_NameSaved: The device name has been saved.
Profile_Device_SyncTurnedOn: Synchronization with this device has been enabled for this profile.
Profile_Device_SyncTurnedOff: Synchronization with this device has been disabled for this profile.
Profile_Device_Disconnected: The device has been disconnected from your profile.
Profile_Device_Disconnect_Warning: Only continue if you really want to detach this device from your profile. After detaching it, you should not make further account changes on that device, because during the next synchronization your profile will be removed from it.
Profile_LocalSync_Title: Change this profile’s synchronization on the current device
Profile_LocalSync_Warning: This setting applies only to the currently signed-in user on this device. When it is off, this user’s data is neither sent from nor received by this device. Other local users are unaffected. If every local user turns synchronization off, the device’s synchronization services stop automatically.
Profile_LocalSync_OnSuccess: Synchronization has been enabled for this profile on the current device.
Profile_LocalSync_OffSuccess: Synchronization has been disabled for this profile on the current device.
Passwords_Reveal_Hint: The actual password is not loaded or shown until you explicitly request it.
Login_DeviceTransfer_Title: Bring your profile from another device
Login_DeviceTransfer_Description: Use this when your profile already exists on another device on the same local network. This device will show a short one-time code and a QR code for the same code. On your already signed-in device, open the Devices main menu item, choose Add device, then either scan the QR code, upload a QR image, or enter the code manually. After the profile data is copied, you can sign in here with your existing account password.
Login_DeviceTransfer_CodeDescription: Keep this screen open and scan the QR code or enter the code on the device where you are already signed in. The code is temporary and only works on the same local network.
Login_DeviceTransfer_Waiting: Waiting for the other device to confirm the code and copy the profile data...
Login_DeviceTransfer_SuccessMessage: Your profile data has been copied to this device. Press OK, then sign in with your existing account password.
Login_DeviceTransfer_ErrorMessage: Device enrollment could not be completed.
Login_DeviceTransfer_CodeReady: The QR code and connection code are ready. Use them on the device where you are already signed in.
Profile_Device_Add_Description: Open the sign-in screen on the new device, choose the option to sign in from another device, then use the QR code or connection code shown there. Both devices must be on the same local network.
Profile_Device_Add_Code_Label: Connection code from the new device
Profile_Device_AddSyncDisabled: This profile cannot add another device while its synchronization is disabled on the current device. Enable synchronization for this profile first.
Profile_Device_AddSuccess: The new device has been added and the initial profile data transfer has completed.
Profile_Device_Add_CodeRequired: Enter the connection code shown on the new device.
Shell_ProfilePasswordChangedLoggedOut: Your profile password was changed on another device, so you were logged out automatically. Sign in again with your new credentials.
Shell_ProfileRemovedLoggedOut: This profile is no longer linked to this device, so you were logged out automatically.
Shell_SessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
Shell_SessionRenewal_Message: Your session will expire in about one minute. Do you want to extend your login for another 30 minutes?
Shell_SessionRenewed: Your session was extended for another 30 minutes.
Shell_SessionRenewalDeclined: Session extension was declined. You will be logged out when the current session expires.
Shell_SessionRenewalFailed: The session could not be extended. You will be logged out when the current session expires.
Error_Generic: Error: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
Error_InvalidInput: Error: The provided data is invalid or incomplete.
Error_InvalidCredentials: Error: The username or password is incorrect.
Error_InvalidSession: Error: Your session has expired or is invalid. Please sign in again.
Error_NotFound: Error: The requested item could not be found.
Error_DuplicatePasswordName: A password with this name already exists. Choose a different name.
Error_LimitReached: Error: The allowed limit has been reached.
Error_DataIntegrity: Error: The data is corrupted or could not be verified.
Error_DeviceIdentity: Error: The device identity is not initialized.
Passwords_Editor_Closed_Description: Use the list actions to add a new password or edit an existing one.
Passwords_SearchEmpty_Description: No passwords match the current search. Change the search text or sort order.
Passwords_Editor_PasswordHint_Revealed: The current password has been loaded into the field and can be edited.
Passwords_DeleteConfirm_Message: Are you sure you want to delete this password: “{0}”? This action cannot be undone.
Passwords_ColorPicker_Description: Set the password color with sliders or by entering an ARGB/RGB hex color code manually. Examples: #FFFFD700, #FFD700, or #FD0.
Passwords_ColorPicker_InvalidCode: Invalid color code. Use #RGB, #ARGB, #RRGGBB, or #AARRGGBB format.
Profile_Device_SearchEmpty_Description: Try a different device name or status.
Profile_EditPersonalInfo_Description: Change your name and email address.
Profile_ChangeUsername_Description: Change the sign-in name used for your profile.
Profile_ChangeMasterPassword_Description: Change the master password for this account.
Profile_DeleteAccount_Warning_Title: Are you sure you want to delete your profile?
Profile_DeleteAccount_FinalWarning: This action cannot be undone. The local user record and stored data for this profile will be permanently removed from this device. Continue only if you are completely sure.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_Generic: Error: Device enrollment could not be completed. Please try again.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_SyncDisabled: Error: Synchronization is disabled on this device. Turn synchronization on before adding a new device.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_InvalidCode: Error: The device enrollment code is invalid or incomplete.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_NewDeviceNotFound: Error: The new device could not be found on the local network. Keep the code screen open and make sure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi/network. On Windows, the firewall must allow inbound local-subnet traffic for this app.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_NewDeviceConnecti: Error: The new device details were found, but this device could not connect to it or transfer the profile data. If one device is on Wi-Fi and the other is wired, this is often caused by Wi-Fi/AP client isolation, guest Wi-Fi isolation, router LAN-WLAN isolation, a Windows network profile, or inbound firewall rules. Keep the code screen open and allow inbound local network traffic for this app.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_NewDeviceRejected: Error: The new device rejected the profile transfer. Generate a new code and try again.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_CodeExpired: Error: The device enrollment code expired. Generate a new code and try again.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_CodeProofInvalid: Error: The device enrollment code could not be verified. Generate a new code and try again.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_ProfileDataInvali: Error: The received profile data could not be imported.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_ProfileDataTooLar: Error: The profile data is too large to transfer in one enrollment request.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_DeviceIdentityCon: Error: A different device already uses this device identity.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_LocalNetworkUnava: Error: No usable local network connection was found on this device. Connect it to Wi-Fi or Ethernet, then try again.
Error_DeviceEnrollment_LocalEnrollmentLi: Error: The local enrollment service could not start or verify its network listener. Keep the app open, reconnect to the local network, and try again.
Firewall_Message: PasswordManagerLocal needs local-network access for device synchronization and enrollment. The app will ask Windows to add effective Windows Defender Firewall rules for PasswordManagerLocal: inbound TCP port 26688, inbound mDNS UDP port 5353, and application-specific outbound TCP/UDP rules for the same traffic. It will also replace conflicting block rules that target this executable. Do you want to allow this in Windows Firewall? The next window will be a Windows administrator permission prompt.
Firewall_Failed: Windows Firewall could not be configured or the new rules are not effective for the active network profile. Try allowing it again. You can also run ConfigureWindowsFirewall.bat as administrator from the application folder. Check that Block all incoming connections is disabled for the active Windows Firewall profile and that no effective inbound or outbound Block rule targets PasswordManagerLocal.Windows.exe, TCP 26688, or UDP 5353.
Firewall_RequiredForLocalNetwork: Windows Firewall access is required before device enrollment or local synchronization can start. Choose Allow and approve the administrator prompt, then try again.
Shell_BackendStartupFailed: The background service could not start. Please restart the application.
Shell_LogoutConfirm_Message: Do you want to log out of the current profile?
Shell_ExitConfirm_Message: Do you want to close Password Manager Local?
Login_DeviceTransfer_CodeReadabilityHint: For readability, zeros are shown with a slash: 0̸. This makes them easier to distinguish from the letter O.
Profiles_Subtitle: Choose another signed-in profile on this device, or sign in to a different account.
Profiles_Empty_Description: Sign in to another account to add a profile to this device.
Shell_SessionRenewal_ProfileMessage: The session for {0} will expire in about one minute. Do you want to extend that login for another 30 minutes?
Error_ProfileAlreadyLoggedIn: Error: This profile is already signed in on this device. Choose it from Change profile instead.
Shell_RememberMeEnabled: Remember me is enabled for this profile on this device.
Shell_RememberMeDisabled: Remember me is disabled for this profile on this device.
Shell_RememberMeUpdateFailed: Remember me could not be changed. Please try again.
Shell_ChooseRememberedProfile: Choose which remembered profile to open.
Profiles_Startup_Subtitle: Multiple remembered profiles are available on this device. Choose one to continue, or sign in to another account.
Login_DeviceTransfer_QrCodeLabel: Scan this QR code from the device where you are already signed in.
Profile_Device_Add_QrOptions_Description: Fast options: scan the QR code from the new device, or upload a picture that contains that QR code. The manual code field remains available below.
Profile_Device_Add_QrCameraUnavailable: Camera QR scanning is not available on this platform. Use Upload QR image or enter the code manually.
Profile_Device_Add_QrNotFound: No readable QR code was found in the selected image.
Profile_Device_Add_QrDecodeFailed: The QR code image could not be read. Try a clearer image or enter the code manually.
Profile_Device_Add_QrScanner_Description: Point the camera at the QR code shown on the new device. Only PasswordManagerLocal enrollment QR codes are accepted.
DatabaseVersion_Error_Message: The saved database uses version {0}, but this app supports versions {1} through {2}. The database cannot be opened and the app cannot be used. You can reset the database to continue, but resetting permanently deletes every locally saved profile, password, device relationship, synchronization record, and setting. Do you want to reset the database now?
DatabaseVersion_InvalidHeader_Message: The database configuration header is missing, damaged, or uses an unsupported format. The database cannot be opened and the app cannot be used. You can reset the database to continue, but resetting permanently deletes every locally saved profile, password, device relationship, synchronization record, and setting. Do you want to reset the database now?
DatabaseVersion_ResetConfirm_Message: Final warning: this operation cannot be undone. The current encrypted database, its protected key, all profiles, saved passwords, linked-device information, synchronization state, and every other locally stored item will be permanently deleted. A completely new empty database, new database key, and new DbConfig file will be created. Do you still want to continue?
DatabaseVersion_ResetDeclined_Message: The database was not reset. Password Manager Local cannot open or use this unsupported database, so the application must remain locked. Close the app, or choose Reset database to create a new empty database.
DatabaseVersion_Resetting_Message: Deleting the incompatible database and creating a new empty database with a new protected key. Do not close the app during this operation.
DatabaseVersion_ResetFailed_Message: The incompatible database could not be fully removed or the new database could not be created. The app remains locked. Check that the application can write to its local data folder, then go back and try again.
